risks.description: the detail screen may display an owner or next action the durable store does not hold
assigning an exception may not durably record the owner

scenarios.title: an unassigned exception is shown as unassigned
scenarios.purpose: a screen that invents an owner sends an operator to a person who was never told
scenarios.rationale: the acceptance criterion is about what a person can see versus what is stored
scenarios.generating_risk: the screen may fabricate an owner or a next action

persisted_state_checks.name: the store holds no owner for EX-1

scenarios.title: assigning through the screen durably records the owner
scenarios.purpose: an assignment a reload forgets is not an assignment
scenarios.rationale: the screen is the only way an operator assigns, so the write must survive a reload
scenarios.generating_risk: the click may update only the rendered page
scenarios.isolation_note: runs against its own freshly started service; the store is recreated at start

assumptions: the exception detail screen is served at /
